flow.heading: How Nabta Transforms Your Agricultural Operation
flow.subtitle: A continuous intelligence loop connecting real ground telemetry to international supply lines.
flow.step1Desc: Soil chemistry tests (pH, EC, NPK), water allocations, and geospatial boundary mapping are ingested.
flow.step2Desc: Multi-spectral Sentinel-2 satellite passes evaluate vegetative canopy vigor and evapotranspiration stress.
flow.step3Desc: Algorithmic ranking matches your micro-climate with optimal cultivars, estimating production, capex, and ROI.
flow.step4Desc: The engine prescribes the exact hybrid seeds, soluble fertigation, and drip equipment required for your scenario.
flow.step5Desc: Procure certified inputs directly from international verified manufacturers with cross-border escrow protection.

globalRibbon.title: Engineered for Global Agribusiness
globalRibbon.desc: Deploying precision agricultural intelligence across multiple continents, currencies, and languages with cross-border trade settlements.

pillars.heading: From Satellite Observation to Commercial Settlement
pillars.subtitle: Eliminating guesswork in agriculture by connecting raw telemetry data directly to financial scenario models and global supply chains.
pillars.p1Desc: Sentinel-2 and PlanetScope satellite imagery ingested every 3 days. Real-time NDVI, moisture stress (CWSI), and thermal indices calibrated to plot coordinates.
pillars.p2Desc: In-depth soil profiling covering pH, electrical conductivity (EC), organic matter, and N-P-K reserves. Continuous salinity risk tracking to protect plant vigor.
pillars.p3Desc: Compare multi-crop strategies side-by-side. Calculate exact water consumption (m³/ha), field duration, capex inputs, and anticipated net margin per hectare.
pillars.p4Desc: Automated matching between the chosen farming scenario and verified international input suppliers. Order hybrid seeds, specialty fertilizers, and drip systems with escrow.
